bodyJa: ママと同じ顔なのに、ママじゃない。少女ベラの家に入り込む不気味な存在を描く超常ホラー。ジェシカ・チャステインが母親とその姿をした怪異を演じ、ジェームズ・ワンが製作、ロブ・サヴェッジが監督を担当。家という安心できる場所が、いちばん怖い場所に変わっていく。
bodyEn: It looks like her mother. But it isn’t. A sinister presence enters young Bella’s home in this supernatural horror starring Jessica Chastain as both the mother and the entity wearing her face. Produced by James Wan and directed by Rob Savage, it turns the comfort of home into something deeply unsettling.

bodyJa: ネットで語り継がれてきた、あの不気味な村の話が映画に。巨大な頭を持つ存在が現れる都市伝説「巨頭オ」を、近藤亮太監督が映像化。前田拳太郎と久保史緒里が出演する、年末に待つ異様な一作。村系ホラーが好きなら気にしておきたい。
bodyEn: An unsettling village legend makes its way from the internet to the screen. Director Ryota Kondo adapts the online story of beings with enormous heads, with Kentaro Maeda and Shiori Kubo in the cast. A year-end release to watch if eerie village horror is your thing.

bodyJa: 届いた動画に映っていたのは、自分の死。旧校舎で見つけた古いスマホをきっかけに、高校生たちへ不気味なAI動画が届き始める。早瀬憩主演、山元環監督・脚本。毎日触るスマホが恐怖の入口になる、身近さが嫌な余韻を残しそうなホラー。
bodyEn: The video on your phone shows your own death. After discovering an old smartphone in a disused school building, a group of high-school students start receiving disturbing AI-generated videos. Starring Ikoi Hayase and written and directed by Tamaki Yamamoto, this horror turns an everyday device into a doorway to dread.
